endpoints.name: add address
endpoints.description:
This endpoint adds a new address for the user.
      
    It receives address details
    It saves the new address
    It can set it as default
    Simple meaning: this API is used when a user adds a shipping or billing address.

endpoints.name: update address
endpoints.description:
This endpoint updates an existing address.
      
    It modifies the selected address details
    It saves the changes
    Simple meaning: this API is used when a user edits an address.

endpoints.name: delete address
endpoints.description:
This endpoint deletes an address.
      
    It finds the address by ID
    It removes it
    It returns success
    Simple meaning: this API is used when a user removes an address.

endpoints.name: get all addresses
endpoints.description:
This endpoint gets all saved addresses of the logged-in user.
      
    It returns the user’s address list
    It can show the default and other addresses
    Simple meaning: this API is used to view the user’s saved addresses.
endpoints.exampleName: Get addresses recorded by a specific user

endpoints.name: get brand
endpoints.description:
This endpoint gets one specific brand from the database.
      
    You can search by brand id, name, or slug
    It returns the matching brand if it exists
    If the brand is not found, it returns an error
    In simple words: this API is used when you want to view one brand only, such as a single brand by its name or unique ID.

endpoints.name: list related Brands
endpoints.description:
This endpoint gets all brands that belong to a specific category or sub-category.
      
    You can filter by category
    You can also filter by subCategory
    It returns the brands connected to that category or sub-category
    In simple words: this API is used when you want to show brands that are related to a selected category or sub-category, such as “all brands under Men’s Shoes”.
endpoints.exampleName: Get related brands for specific category , sub-category or both

endpoints.name: list all brands
endpoints.description:
This endpoint is used to get a list of all brands.
        
    It gives you extra features through ApiFeatures, so you can:
        
    paginate the results
    filter brands by conditions
    search brands by keyword
    sort brands by name or other fields
    In the easiest way:
        
    pagination() → split results into pages
    filter() → show only matching brands
    search() → find brands by text
    sort() → order the list
    Example requests:
        
    GET /brands?page=1&limit=10 → first page, 10 brands
    GET /brands?search=apple → find brands with “apple”
    GET /brands?sort=-name → sort from Z to A
    GET /brands?name=Apple → show only Apple brand
    The response includes:
        
    total: total number of matching brands
    page: current page
    data: the list of brands
    This makes the API easier to use in dashboards, frontend pages, and product filters.

endpoints.name: add to cart
endpoints.description:
This endpoint adds a product to the cart.
      
    It checks the product and user
    It adds the item to the cart
    It may update quantity if already exists
    Simple meaning: this API is used when a user adds an item to the cart.

bodyJson.message: Product has been added to cart

endpoints.name: remove from cart
endpoints.description:
This endpoint removes a product from the cart.
      
    It finds the cart item
    It deletes it from the cart
    Simple meaning: this API is used when a user removes an item from the cart.

bodyJson.message: Product has been removed form cart

endpoints.name: update cart
endpoints.description:
This endpoint updates the cart item quantity.
      
    It changes the product quantity
    It saves the updated cart
    Simple meaning: this API is used when a user changes the number of items in the cart.
endpoints.exampleName: Update product quantity in a cart

endpoints.name: get cart
endpoints.description:
This endpoint returns the current cart.
      
    It lists the products in the cart
    It may show total price or quantities
    Simple meaning: this API is used to view the user’s shopping cart.

endpoints.name: get category
endpoints.description:
This endpoint gets one specific category from the database.
      
    You can search by category id, name, or slug
    It returns the matching category if it exists
    If no search value is provided, it returns an error
    If the category is not found, it returns a “not found” error
    In simple words: this API is used when you want to view one category only, such as a single category by its unique ID or name.

endpoints.name: list categories
endpoints.description:
This endpoint is used to get a list of all categories.
        
    It uses ApiFeatures, so it supports:
        
    pagination
    filtering
    searching
    sorting
    This means you can:
        
    show categories in pages
    find a specific category by name or condition
    search category names
    sort the results by a field
    Examples:
        
    GET /categories?page=1&limit=10 → first page, 10 categories
    GET /categories?search=mobile → search by category name
    GET /categories?sort=-name → sort from Z to A
    GET /categories?name=Electronics → show only that category
    The response includes:
        
    total: total number of categories
    page: current page
    data: category list
    Simple meaning: this API is for showing many categories in a clean and organized way.

endpoints.name: get coupons
endpoints.description:
This endpoint gets all available coupons.
      
    It uses ApiFeatures, so it supports:
      
    pagination
    filtering
    sorting
    searching
    Examples:
      
    GET /coupons?page=1&limit=10
    GET /coupons?search=summer
    GET /coupons?sort=-discount
    Simple meaning: this API is used to show coupon offers to users.

endpoints.name: get specific coupon
endpoints.description:
This endpoint gets one specific coupon.
      
    It checks by coupon ID or code
    It returns the matching coupon
    If not found, it gives an error
    Simple meaning: this API is used to show one coupon’s details.

endpoints.name: add order
endpoints.description:
This endpoint creates a new order.
        
    It takes order details
    It validates the items and user
    It saves the new order
    Simple meaning: this API is used when a customer places an order.

endpoints.name: cancel order
endpoints.description:
This endpoint cancels an existing order.
        
    It finds the order
    It changes status to canceled
    It returns success
    Simple meaning: this API is used when a user cancels their order.

endpoints.name: Get user orders
endpoints.description:
This endpoint gets all orders for the logged-in user.
      
    It returns the user’s order history
    It may include statuses and totals
    Simple meaning: this API is used to view a user’s order history.

endpoints.name: Get order details
endpoints.description:
This endpoint gets the details of one order.
      
    It finds the specific order
    It returns complete order information
    Simple meaning: this API is used to view a single order’s full details.

endpoints.name: Deliver order
endpoints.description:
This endpoint marks an order as delivered.
      
    It finds the order
    It updates the delivery status
    Simple meaning: this API is used when the order is delivered to the customer.

endpoints.name: get product by id
endpoints.description:
This endpoint gets one product by its details.
      
    You can search by product ID or other unique values
    It returns the product data if found
    If the product does not exist, it returns an error
    Simple meaning: this API is used to view one product in detail.

data.title: Hatif Nokhba 5G
data.overview: Flagship 5G smartphone with a stunning AMOLED display, pro-grade camera, full Arabic keyboard and interface support, and all-day battery.

endpoints.name: add review
endpoints.description:
This endpoint adds a review for a product.
      
    It checks if the user already reviewed the product
    It checks if the user bought the product
    It saves the review
    Simple meaning: this API is used when a customer leaves feedback about a product.

endpoints.name: list reviews
endpoints.description:
This endpoint gets all reviews.
      
    It uses ApiFeatures when implemented in the list flow, so it can support:
      
    pagination
    filtering by product or user
    sorting by rating
    searching review text
    Examples:
      
    GET /reviews?page=1&limit=10
    GET /reviews?productId=123
    GET /reviews?sort=-reviewRating
    Simple meaning: this API is used to show customer reviews with filtering and sorting.

endpoints.name: get specific sub category
endpoints.description:
This endpoint gets one specific sub-category from the database.
      
    You can search by sub-category id, name, or slug
    It returns the matching sub-category if it exists
    If the sub-category is not found, it returns an error
    In simple words: this API is used when you want to view one sub-category only, such as a single sub-category by its ID or name.

endpoints.name: List sub categories
endpoints.description:
This endpoint is used to get a list of all sub-categories.
        
    It also uses ApiFeatures, so it supports:
        
    pagination
    filtering
    searching
    sorting
    Examples:
        
    GET /sub-categories?page=1&limit=10 → page 1, 10 sub-categories
    GET /sub-categories?categoryId=123 → show sub-categories under a specific category
    GET /sub-categories?search=shoes → search sub-category names
    GET /sub-categories?sort=name → sort from A to Z
    The response includes:
        
    total: total number of matching sub-categories
    page: current page
    data: list of sub-categories
    Simple meaning: this API is for showing many sub-categories with search, filter, and page options.

endpoints.name: Register
endpoints.description:
This endpoint creates a new user account.
    
    It receives username, email, password, and address details
    It validates the data
    It creates the user and default address
    Simple meaning: this API is used when a new user signs up.

endpoints.name: Update account
endpoints.description:
This endpoint updates the logged-in user’s information.
      
    It can update password, email, username, phone, and other account fields
    It can also update the default address
    Simple meaning: this API is used when a user edits their profile.

endpoints.name: Login
endpoints.description:
This endpoint logs a user in.
    
    It checks the email and password
    If correct, it returns a token
    This token is used in protected routes
    Simple meaning: this API is used when a user signs in.

endpoints.name: Get user profile
endpoints.description:
This endpoint returns the current user’s profile.
      
    It gets the user information
    It also gets the default address
    It hides the password in the response
    Simple meaning: this API is used to fetch the logged-in user data.

endpoints.name: Forgot password
endpoints.description:
This endpoint starts the password reset flow.
    
    It checks if the email exists
    It creates an OTP token for password reset
    Simple meaning: this API is used when a user forgets their password.
endpoints.exampleName: First phase of forgotten password phases

bodyJson.message: Otp has been sent on you email ososmeedo@gmail.com successfully

endpoints.name: Verify OTP
endpoints.description:
This endpoint verifies the OTP sent to the user.
    
    It checks the OTP and token
    If correct, it returns a reset token
    Simple meaning: this API is used to confirm the identity of the user before resetting the password.
endpoints.exampleName: Second phase of forgotten password phases

endpoints.name: Reset password
endpoints.description:
This endpoint sets a new password.
    
    It receives the reset token and new password
    It validates the token
    It updates the password
    Simple meaning: this API is used to finish the password reset process.
endpoints.exampleName: Final phase of forgotten password phases

endpoints.name: delete account
endpoints.description:
This endpoint deletes the logged-in user account.
      
    It finds the user
    It removes the account from the database
    It returns success
    Simple meaning: this API is used when the user deletes their account.
endpoints.docsNote: Deletes the throwaway user from register/login throwaway. Hard delete - TEST database only.

bodyJson.message: User account has been deleted successfully
